lane: CONTROL-4 v3 BLIND LANE (fresh context, commitment-first)

commitment_discipline.implemented_from: sealed spec texts only, with this lane's own code

runtime.scipy: absent (own scaling-and-squaring Pade-13 expm written for this lane)

apparatus_reconstruction.carrier: Hermite n=2, spatial dim 8 (lexicographic (a,b,c)), spinor dim 4, total 32
apparatus_reconstruction.h0: sum_j p_j (x) alpha_j, p_j exact truncated Hermite-ladder momentum matrices
apparatus_reconstruction.record_term: lambda v(t) M(t) (x) S_n, M(t)=Q 1_{|x|<=r(t)} Q, r(t)=min(t,1-t)
apparatus_reconstruction.connection: J(t) = -B_D(t) (x) alpha_x, B_D(t) = Q b_D(t,x) Q, b_D = exp(16 - 1/s)
apparatus_reconstruction.falsifier: J'(t) = -( B_D(t) + i*||B_D(t)||_2*A_0 ) (x) alpha_x, amplitude pinned at 100%
apparatus_reconstruction.propagation: Strang N_t=48, Step = F A G_lambda A F, all exponentials by scaling-and-squaring
apparatus_reconstruction.cell_quadrature: 10 radial GL, 10 polar-cosine GL, 20 uniform azimuthal (sealed primary)
apparatus_reconstruction.state_schemes: C_pure = 1_{(-inf,0)}(h_0);  C_mix = Q P_- Q with 20^3 tensor Gauss-Hermite
apparatus_reconstruction.record_data: w = (-1/4, 1/2, -1/4) on lambda = (-sqrt2, 0, +sqrt2), recovered from c, not typed
apparatus_reconstruction.amplitude: Z(a) = sum_lambda w_lambda det(I - C + C U_lambda(a))
derivative_routes: machine-exact closed-form d/da of the sealed Strang product (informs; h-free)

A0_construction.definition: A0[m][n] = +1 if n=m+1, -1 if m=n+1, else 0 in lexicographic (a,b,c); then /||A0||_2

notes_on_enclosures.enclosure_rule: Richardson on the two finest rungs; radius = |Richardson - CD(finest)| (truncation) + the two roundoff allowances 16*eps*max(|Z|,1)/(2h); outward
notes_on_enclosures.broken_pinned_A0_note: the reading is far below the CD roundoff floor (~1e-11), so the certified statement is an UPPER BOUND, not a resolved value; the h-free exact derivative resolves the value
notes_on_enclosures.unbroken_note: Z(+h) and Z(-h) are bit-identical at every rung (CD == 0.0 exactly), reproducing the sealed a-parity lemmas; the certified bound is the smallest roundoff allowance on the ladder

1_BROKEN_pinned_class_leaving_falsifier.verdict: DOES NOT CLEAR THE 1e-9 FLOOR IN ANY OF THE EIGHT CONFIGURATIONS
1_BROKEN_pinned_class_leaving_falsifier.relation_to_frozen_window_1e-8_1e-4: BELOW the window. Certified upper bound 2.27e-11 sits 2.6 decades below the window lower edge 1e-8 and 1.6 decades below the 1e-9 floor; the h-free exact derivative (6.1e-24 to 3.1e-21) sits 13 to 16 decades below the window lower edge.

2_UNBROKEN_sealed_J.verdict: CLEARS THE 1e-12 CEILING IN ALL EIGHT CONFIGURATIONS
2_UNBROKEN_sealed_J.central_difference_is_exactly_zero: Z(+h) and Z(-h) bit-identical at all 8 rungs, all configurations

4_DETECTOR_Psi.detector_is_loaded_antisym_is_O(1e-2): YES on the sealed envelope A pure state (2.10e-2) and on envelope B (2.22e-1); O(1e-3)-O(1e-4) on the mixed state and ell=sqrt2

a_per_slot_vanishing_in_class.note: the sum of ABSOLUTE slot values is itself ~1e-22, so the in-class zero is per-slot, not a +-lambda cancellation

b_same_slot_occupancy_for_class_leaving_.outcome_for_PINNED_A0: FAILS - 0 of 144 slots occupied above 1e-12; the pinned falsifier occupies NO slots
b_same_slot_occupancy_for_class_leaving_.outcome_for_a_tau_EVEN_direction_matched: CONFIRMED - 78 of 144 slots above 1e-12 (26 per lambda), 66 above 1e-9 (22 per lambda), all inside the detector-live set, identical pattern for lambda=+-sqrt2

c_exact_linearity_in_class_leaving_ampli.note: Z'(0) is a linear functional of J; measured exactly linear in the class-leaving amplitude on the resolvable (x-ladder) direction, and the CD readings track it to ~1e-6 relative (finite-h effect)

d_Lemma1_survival_under_the_falsifier.note: holds under both the pinned falsifier and the x-ladder direction; also holds slot-by-slot in the derivative form

e_mixed_vs_pure_class_leaving_identity.note: B_D(t) is exactly DIAGONAL in the sealed lexicographic basis (b_D is radial and the n=2 Hermite indices carry definite parity per axis), while the detector Psi has NO diagonal support; the in-class component therefore contributes exactly nothing and the mixed reading is bit-identical to the pure class-leaving reading

structural_finding_of_this_lane.headline: THE PINNED A_0 IS TRACE-ORTHOGONAL TO THE DETECTOR. The class-leaving channel is LIVE; the pinned falsifier does not touch it.
mechanism: Lemma 2's involution T' = P_x (x) (i gamma^1) forces P_x Psi P_x = -Psi, and the y- and z-axis analogues T_y = P_y (x) (i gamma^2), T_z = P_z (x) (i gamma^3) force P_y Psi P_y = +Psi and P_z Psi P_z = +Psi.

Hence Psi is supported EXACTLY on the x-Hermite-ladder off-diagonal block: entries (m, m+4) in the lexicographic (a,b,c) order, i.e. a=0 <-> a=1 with b and c preserved. Measured: max|Psi| outside that block <= 2.2e-16; max|Psi| inside it ~ 7.4e-3.
The pinned A_0 is the nearest-neighbour shift in the FLAT lexicographic index, supported only on |m-n| = 1. Its support is disjoint from the detector's support {|m-n| = 4}.

Therefore tr[antisym(Psi) A_0] = 0 identically. Measured relative pairing <= 9.9e-17 across all eight configurations, while the pairing of the same antisym(Psi) with the x-ladder direction is 0.9922-0.9998 (essentially perfect alignment).

disambiguating_measurement.what: the same apparatus, the same tau-EVEN class, the same 100% amplitude pin, but with A_0 replaced by the antisymmetric x-Hermite-ladder shift (2-norm already 1)
disambiguating_measurement.status: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. This is NOT a substitute for the pinned falsifier and this lane does not propose it as one. It is reported because S4's refutation criterion turns on whether the alpha_x channel is annihilated in the tau-EVEN grading, and this measurement shows directly that it is NOT.

blind_lane_assessment.which_S3_window_the_broken_reading_falls: NONE. The pinned class-leaving reading falls BELOW the S3(a) window 1e-8 <= |Z'(0)| <= 1e-4 and below the sealed 1e-9 floor. Certified upper bound 2.27e-11 (central-difference, roundoff-limited); h-free exact derivative 6.1e-24 to 3.1e-21. It is 2.6 decades below the window's lower edge on the certified bound (and 1.6 decades below the 1e-9 floor), and 13 to 16 decades below on the exact value.
blind_lane_assessment.S3a_outcome: MISS (low). This is the lane's THIRD consecutive magnitude miss, exactly as the standing calibration warned; but note this miss is not a magnitude error, it is a null.
blind_lane_assessment.S3b_outcome: HIT. Unbroken |Z'(0)| <= 1.11e-13 certified, exact 4.0e-27 to 3.6e-23, inside the predicted <= 1e-18 and well inside the pinned 1e-12 ceiling.
blind_lane_assessment.S3c_outcome: 4 of 5 CONFIRMED (per-slot vanishing, exact linearity, Lemma 1 survival, mixed-vs-pure identity). The 5th - same-slot occupancy for the class-leaving input - FAILS for the pinned A_0 (zero slots occupied) and is CONFIRMED for a detector-matched tau-EVEN direction.
blind_lane_assessment.S4_literal_criterion: LITERALLY SATISFIED: |Z'(0)| < 1e-9 for the pinned falsifier at 100% amplitude, WHILE max_k ||J'(t_k)||_2 = 7.4e-4 to 9.3e-4 > 1e-6 (non-vacuity clears) AND ||antisym(Psi)||_F = 2.1e-2 on the sealed envelope-A pure state (detector loaded).
blind_lane_assessment.S4_stated_interpretation_is_CONTRADICTED: S4 reads that combination as meaning 'the alpha_x channel is annihilated in BOTH tau gradings - a FIFTH protection'. This lane measures the opposite: the tau-ODD grading is annihilated (sym(Psi) <= 3.3e-15, L4 confirmed) but the tau-EVEN grading is NOT (antisym(Psi) = 2.1e-2, and a tau-EVEN direction inside the detector's support reads 5.2e-8 to 4.8e-5). There is no fifth protection. The pinned A_0 simply has zero trace overlap with the live channel.
blind_lane_assessment.recommended_classification: CONTROL-4 v3 DOES NOT BITE AS PINNED - a FOURTH defeated falsifier, but defeated by a DESIGN DEFECT (basis-order/support mismatch between A_0 and the detector), not by a new symmetry. This is the same failure genus as the v1 CONTROL4_DESIGN_DEFECT block, not the L4 genus. Whether the S6 'does not bite' consequence rule should fire on a support-mismatch null, or whether this is instead a fifth control-design defect requiring principal adjudication, is NOT this lane's call.
what_this_lane_does_NOT_claim: It does not claim the teeth proposition is refuted. S4's criterion is met literally but its stated ground (annihilation in both tau gradings) is measured false.

It does not propose, select, or authorize any successor falsifier direction. The x-ladder direction is reported as a diagnostic of the detector's support, discovered while measuring the pinned falsifier, not chosen for its output.
It does not re-run, revise, or reinterpret any frozen prediction.
